# Grants and Hacks

> Hackathons, incubator / accelerator intakes and equity-free startup grants, Australia first, plus major global programs. Updated every Monday. Every listing links to its official source; confirm details there before applying.

Last updated: 2026-11-18

## Sections
- [Startup grants](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/): amount, eligibility, deadline, official source
- [Hackathons](https://grantsandhacks.com/hackathons/): theme, location, dates, registration, prizes, eligibility
- [Incubators & accelerators](https://grantsandhacks.com/accelerators/): deadlines, terms, eligibility
- [Guides](https://grantsandhacks.com/guides/): plain answers for early-stage founders

## Guides
- [Can an Australian sole trader get startup grants?](https://grantsandhacks.com/guides/can-a-sole-trader-get-startup-grants-australia/): Most Australian startup grants and the R&D Tax Incentive require a company. Here is what a sole trader can and cannot apply for, with official sources.
- [What startup grants are available in Australia in 2027?](https://grantsandhacks.com/guides/startup-grants-australia-2027/): A checked summary of the main equity-free grants and incentives for Australian startups heading into 2027: amounts, who qualifies and current status.
- [How to prepare a hackathon project](https://grantsandhacks.com/guides/how-to-prepare-a-hackathon-project/): A practical checklist for preparing a hackathon project: what to do before the event, how to scope a demo, and how to pitch to judges.

## Current grants
- [NSW MVP Ventures Program](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/nsw-mvp-ventures-program/): A$20k–50k; Stream 2 (majority women-owned/run, regional or First Nations) up to A$75k
- [NSW Regional Event Fund · Event Development stream](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/nsw-regional-event-fund-event-development-stream/): One-off grant up to A$50K, no equity
- [NSW Regional Event Fund (Incubator and Flagship streams)](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/nsw-regional-event-fund-incubator-and-flagship-streams/): Incubator up to A$20K; Flagship A$20K a year (A$30K a year for 3 years after three annual grants). No equity
- [R&D Tax Incentive](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/r-and-d-tax-incentive/): Loss-making companies get up to 43.5% back in cash
- [CSIRO Kick-Start](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/csiro-kick-start/): A$20k–60k of R&D funding (as a CSIRO voucher), matched 1:1 in cash
- [Industry Growth Program](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/industry-growth-program/): Early-stage commercialisation A$50k–250k; commercialisation and growth A$100k–5m; covers up to 50% of eligible spending
- [Business Research and Innovation Initiative (BRII)](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/business-research-and-innovation-initiative-brii/): Up to A$100k feasibility; up to A$1m proof of concept (by invitation)
- [MedTech Innovator 2027](https://grantsandhacks.com/grants/medtech-innovator-2027/): Up to US$500k
